verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a sales tax compliance product, so marketplace-facilitator handling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions marketplace facilitators, Amazon or app-store transactions, or excluding facilitator-collected tax from remittance while still counting it toward nexus. Transaction sync, nexus lookback and filings are documented, but they are adjacent features and do not show the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance lead, marketplace sales are modeled correctly — transactions where a facilitator (Amazon, app stores) collected the tax are tracked for nexus and reporting without being double-remitted
